task.title: Remove recovery codes for two-factor authentication (2FA)
task.shortdesc: You can remove existing recovery codes from your Red Hat account. If you remove recovery codes for codes completely, you do not recieve the option to "Use a recovery code instead" when attempting to log in to your Red Hat account.

ul.li: Ensure you have created recovery codes for your Red Hat account.
Confirm that you can log in to your user account.

step.cmd: Log in to your Red Hat user account on any Red Hat site, such as Red Hat Customer Portal.
Click your user avatar in the upper right corner of the panel.

substep.cmd: Click Account details. A page opens where you can edit your account information.
If you log in through Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console, click My profile under your user avatar to edit your account information.

step.cmd: Click Account details. A page opens where you can edit your account information.
On the Login & password page scroll down to 2-factor authentication and click Manage 2-factor authentication. The Signing in page opens.

info.p: After you remove recovery codes, you can create a new set.
